definition: a group of representatives sent somewhere
description: In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.

taps.phrase: to glance up at the camera

en.question: What is the seated woman wearing?

es.answer: Lleva puesta una americana verde azulado.
phrases: levantar la vista hacia la cámara
estrecharle la mano a la mujer
es.question: ¿Qué lleva puesto la mujer sentada?

fr.answer: Elle porte un blazer bleu canard.
